Friday, September 11 through Sunday, September 13: It's the End-of-Summer Shop Hop in Avalon, with dozens of local businesses offering big end-of-season discounts on clothing, shoes, accessories, home décor, and more.

Also that weekend, the North Wildwood Recreation Department holds its 56th annual Surf Fishing Competition. Registration is at the gazebo at Third and JFK in North Wildwood. It costs $15 to participate, with adult and youth divisions and prizes up for grabs. [...] Sunday, September 13: The ARC of Cumberland County holds its 22nd annual Walk-a-thon from 9 AM to noon at Parvin State Park in Pittsgrove.
